\section{\texttt{StreamMetadata}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.schemas.StreamMetadata}\label{schema:StreamMetadata}\index{Classes!StreamMetadata}

Payload of the final \texttt{metadata} SSE event of the `/query/stream` endpoint.
\apifield{Inherits}\texttt{BaseModel}
\apifield{Fields}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{provider}] \texttt{str}, required
  \item[\texttt{latency\_\allowbreak{}ms}] \texttt{float}, required
  \item[\texttt{route}] \texttt{str}, required
  \item[\texttt{confidence}] \texttt{float}, required
  \item[\texttt{sources}] \texttt{list[str]\allowbreak{}}, required
  \item[\texttt{retrieval\_\allowbreak{}scores}] \texttt{list[float]\allowbreak{}}, required
  \item[\texttt{citations}] \texttt{list[Citation]\allowbreak{}}, required
  \item[\texttt{recommended\_\allowbreak{}actions}] \texttt{list[str]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{list()\allowbreak{}}
  \item[\texttt{guardrail}] \texttt{GuardrailDecision \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Sent after all \texttt{content} chunks so streaming clients can render the answer incrementally and then attach evidence, scores, and timing: \texttt{provider} names the LLM provider class, \texttt{latency\_\allowbreak{}ms} measures the full answer-generation time, \texttt{sources} lists the cited document IDs in citation order, and \texttt{retrieval\_\allowbreak{}scores} carries the per-citation retrieval scores.
